description: Additive M4-04 field-bearing view of the accepted release-2500--2599 ZOOM ZOO case. Controller schedules, ROM/core/options and whole-state expectation are unchanged.
tested_behavior: Reference-only perturbation projection: exact through frame 2499, Right input release at 2500, subsequent original motion response, and return at 2600. No native ZOOM ZOO support is claimed.

inputs.injection_point: Buttons are presented on the libretro input callback before retro_run of the frame numbered `from`..`to` (0-based frames after power-on) and withdrawn before the following frame; the core polls the controllers once per frame (R-0002 finding 6). Sub-frame timing is not available.

fields.name: wram_sha256
fields.description: SHA-256 of the complete 128 KiB work RAM at end of frame; retained accepted whole-state identity.

fields.name: registers
fields.description: CPU registers at end of frame; retained accepted whole-state identity.

fields.name: phase_counters
fields.description: $0300 contact phase, $0301 padding, $0302 progress phase; u8 values sampled at end of frame.

fields.name: input_images_axes
fields.description: $0311 JOY1L, $0313 JOY1H, $0315 vertical axis, $0319 horizontal axis, including observed intervening bytes; u8 at end of frame.

fields.name: pose_indices
fields.description: $0411/$0413 player/opponent u16 pose indices published before contact.

fields.name: positions
fields.description: $0415/$0417 x and $0419/$041B y, player/opponent u16 coordinate words.

fields.name: fractional_residues
fields.description: $0401/$0403 signed x and $0405/$0407 signed y integration residues, player/opponent s16 bit patterns.

fields.name: velocities
fields.description: $04BB/$04BD x and $04BF/$04C1 y velocities, player/opponent s16 in 1/32 coordinate units.

fields.name: jump_phase
fields.description: $04C3/$04C5 held-jump phases and $04C7 animation counter, u16 words.

fields.name: orientations
fields.description: $04CB/$04CD player/opponent orientation, u16 modulo-64 values.

fields.name: contact_previous_x
fields.description: $04D7/$04D9 player/opponent previous pre-correction x, u16 coordinates.

fields.name: contact_previous_y
fields.description: $04DB/$04DD player/opponent previous pre-correction y, u16 coordinates.

fields.name: contact_auxiliary
fields.description: $04DF/$04E1 player/opponent auxiliary contact words; other branch meanings remain provisional.

fields.name: contact_angle_sentinels
fields.description: $04EB/$04ED player/opponent angle-sentinel flags, binary u16 in the observed domain.

fields.name: contact_counts
fields.description: $054B/$054D player/opponent unsupported-contact counters, u16.

fields.name: contact_previous_counts
fields.description: $054F/$0551 player/opponent snapshots of incoming unsupported-contact count, u16.

fields.name: surface_angles
fields.description: $0B6E/$0B70 player/opponent contact surface-angle words; signed interpretation remains branch-dependent.

fields.name: contact_selected_high
fields.description: $0B72/$0B74 player/opponent selected-sample high bytes stored as u16.

fields.name: contact_response_b
fields.description: $0BB3/$0BB5 response-A and $0BB7/$0BB9 response-B orientation increments, s16 bit patterns.

fields.name: pose_history
fields.description: $0B5A-$0B7D bounded pose/displacement history region; named members are interpreted by the projection.

fields.name: reflection_flags
fields.description: $0BA7/$0BA9 player/opponent reflection flags, observed binary u16 values.

fields.name: throttles
fields.description: $0BEB/$0BED player/opponent signed throttle integrators.

fields.name: jump_state
fields.description: $0BDB-$0BE8 jump baseline/previous-input and adjacent continuation words; named members are interpreted by the seed inventory.

fields.name: reward_cooldown
fields.description: $0CA7 opponent reward queue cooldown, u16.

fields.name: reward_queue
fields.description: $0CEB-$0D0A complete 32-byte opponent reward queue.

fields.name: reward_cursors
fields.description: $0D11/$0D13 queue read/write cursors captured as bytes plus intervening bytes.

fields.name: opponent_ai
fields.description: $0C6F-$0C7C opponent impulse countdown, trick selector and small-motion/AI continuation words; member meanings stay limited to R-0011.

fields.name: quarter_state
fields.description: $0D25-$0D44 bounded quarter-turn, orientation impulse, jump latch and prior-brake state; projection names observed members.

fields.name: track_wrap_mask
fields.description: $0D4F u16 mask applied to integrated x by $82:A6F3.

fields.name: pose_idle_state
fields.description: $0E77-$0E94 bounded idle-pose state; semantics beyond named continuation members remain provisional.

fields.name: reflected_orientations
fields.description: $0DE9/$0DEB player/opponent reflected combined orientation modulo 64.

fields.name: timer
fields.description: $0E19/$0E1D/$0E21/$0E25/$0E29 timer digits in four-byte slots, u16 values at end of frame.

fields.name: contact_selected_words
fields.description: $0E9F/$0EA1 player/opponent latest selected contact descriptor words.

fields.name: rolling_flags
fields.description: $0EA3/$0EA5 player/opponent rolling flags, binary u16.

fields.name: finish_flags
fields.description: $0EFF/$0F01 player/opponent finish flags, binary u16 when set by the observed finish recorder.

fields.name: finish_delay_counter
fields.description: $0F0F finish-delay counter observed by the next-frame dispatcher.

fields.name: jump_latches
fields.description: $0D39/$0D3B pending jump and $0D3D adjacent state, u16 words.

fields.name: progress
fields.description: $0FC1/$0FC3 unsupported duration, $0FC5/$0FC7 progress marker, $0FC9/$0FCB transition count and $0FCD/$0FCF tag; player/opponent u16.

fields.name: learned_weight
fields.description: $2102 learned event-1 weight, u8.

fields.name: countdown
fields.description: $11C5 countdown word used by riding/timer gates.

fields.name: reward_boosts
fields.description: $11DB/$11DD horizontal and $11DF/$11E1 vertical reward boosts for player/opponent, u16 bit patterns.

fields.name: quarter_counts
fields.description: $1203-$1212 forward/reverse turn and quarter counters for both riders, u16.

fields.name: global_update_counters
fields.description: $127F boost-decay/update counter and adjacent byte, u8.

fields.name: quarter_initialized
fields.description: $136B/$136D player/opponent quarter tracker initialized flags, binary u16.
